response.justification: Bogdan is a strong senior individual contributor with deep experience in developer tooling, testing infrastructure, and CI/CD, but the role is fundamentally a people-management position requiring at least 2 years of formal people leadership and 3 years in a technical leadership role — neither of which is evidenced in his career history. His mobile experience is limited and dated, and there is no track record of managing performance, roadmaps for teams, or organizational change. He would be a compelling candidate for a staff-level IC role in engineering productivity, but not this management position.
strengths: Extensive hands-on experience with developer tools and test infrastructure (test runners, assertion libraries, Selenium training, CI/CD setup)
18+ years of broad software development experience across web, mobile, embedded, and high-scale backend systems
Demonstrated knowledge-sharing and mentorship through workshops, courses, and community talks
concerns: No formal people-management or direct-report leadership experience on the resume
Mobile platform experience is limited and dated (iOS/Apple TV work ended in 2016)
No evidence of strategic roadmap ownership, organizational change leadership, or performance management
